testimonial1_text: We've worked together with Resultant consultants to design and implement a modern succession system. This enhances the value of our company's practice of managing key personnel and developing their successors. The project was well-planned and professionally executed. Resultant provided comprehensive technical support and innovative modifications to existing processes, all while demonstrating a focused and enthusiastic work ethic.
testimonial2_text: As a company, we place a high value on measuring organizational climate, employee happiness, and engagement. By looking at trends on a regular basis, we can quickly see where action needs to be taken and how it worked. The Resultant team operates in a professional and ethical manner. They are very professional and reliable. Most importantly, they listen to our problems and are willing to meet our unique needs and expectations.
testimonial3_text: At our organization, DNLA programs are used to assess the leadership competencies of our employees and to aid in the selection process. We are pleased with DNLA's performance and the quality of the reports we have received. The measurement's results assist us in making business decisions and personnel development. The services provided by Resultant are professional and of high quality.
testimonial4_text: Since 2016, we've been working with Resultant consultants. We have made significant progress in recognizing and developing our employees' leadership talents thanks to the systematic application of the DNLA approach for measuring potential and leadership skills. We also conducted a full SiOK organizational climate survey for all Sava Insurance Group firms in collaboration with their consulting staff. They are professional in their work and have a strong understanding of our needs.
testimonial5_text: We've formed a strategic alliance with Resultant to (co) create new HR solutions for our mutual clients. Working together has been a fantastic experience for us. They approach cooperative development projects with enthusiasm, commitment, and an eye toward excellence. We've reached a point in our relationship where we can confidently rely on the Resultant team because we share similar business values.
